dataset_info.name: Indoor Navigation Dataset
dataset_info.description: Dataset for evaluating PaliGemma models on indoor navigation assistance for visually impaired users

images.description: Long school corridor with multiple doors on the left side and open windows on the right
suggested_questions: Is the path clear to walk?
images.expected_answer: A long corridor with doors on the left and windows on the right. The path is clear.

images.description: Modern curved corridor with wooden wall panels and a bench
suggested_questions: Is there any obstacle in the corridor?
What is on the right side?
images.expected_answer: A curved corridor with a wooden bench along the right wall. The path curves to the left.

images.description: Long straight corridor with striped floor tiles and doors on both sides
suggested_questions: Are there doors on both sides?
images.expected_answer: A long straight corridor with alternating dark and light floor tiles. Doors are visible on both sides.

images.description: Dark corridor with dim lighting, doors on sides, fire extinguisher visible
suggested_questions: Are there any safety elements visible?
images.expected_answer: A dimly lit corridor with doors on both sides. A fire extinguisher is visible on the wall.

images.description: White double doors with golden handles, wooden parquet floor
suggested_questions: What type of door is this?
How do I open this door?
images.expected_answer: A white double door with golden handles. Push the left handle to open.

images.description: White bathroom door with male and female restroom symbols
suggested_questions: What does the sign on the door indicate?
images.expected_answer: This is a bathroom door with male and female symbols indicating a unisex restroom.

images.description: Glass emergency exit doors with green exit sign above
images.expected_answer: Glass emergency exit doors with a green exit sign. Stairs are visible through the glass.

images.description: Open red door leading to an outdoor area with stairs
suggested_questions: Is this door open or closed?
images.expected_answer: An open red door leading to an outdoor area with stairs going up.

images.description: Building staircase with metal handrail and wall-mounted lights
images.expected_answer: A staircase going up with a metal handrail on the left. Wall-mounted lights provide illumination.

images.description: Modern floating staircase with wooden steps and glass railing
suggested_questions: What type of stairs are these?
images.expected_answer: Modern floating stairs with wooden steps and a glass safety railing on the right side.

images.description: Wooden staircase viewed from above with traditional railing
suggested_questions: Are these stairs going up or down?
images.expected_answer: Wooden stairs going down with a traditional wooden railing. Multiple flights are visible.

images.description: Simple wooden staircase with railing, looking up towards windows
images.expected_answer: Wooden stairs going up towards a landing with windows. A wooden handrail is on the right.

images.description: Hotel corridor with cleaning cart blocking the path
suggested_questions: What obstacle is in the way?
images.expected_answer: A hotel corridor with a cleaning cart in the middle of the path. Walk around it to continue.

images.description: School corridor with recycling bins in the center of the path
suggested_questions: What obstacles are in the corridor?
images.expected_answer: Blue recycling bins are blocking the center of the corridor. Walk around them on either side.

images.description: School corridor with a bench along the wall and a person walking
suggested_questions: Is there anyone in the corridor?
images.expected_answer: A corridor with a bench on the right side. A person is walking towards you.

images.description: Office corridor with bathroom sign pointing direction
images.expected_answer: A bathroom sign shows restrooms are ahead to the right. Male and female symbols with an arrow.

images.description: Hotel corridor with illuminated green EXIT sign and door at end
suggested_questions: Is there an emergency exit nearby?
images.expected_answer: A green illuminated EXIT sign above indicates the emergency exit. A door is at the end of the corridor.

images.description: Elevator entrance with accessibility sign showing wheelchair symbol
images.expected_answer: An elevator with accessibility signage showing it is wheelchair accessible. Call buttons are on the left.
